After walking through the chest-high gate and crossing an immaculate yard with a beautiful miniature fountain, you're left to wait for any response from inside the house before you. It's odd that the mother of the kid you got expelled would invite you over like this. She looked like she never wanted to see you again after what you did.*

"You fucking PRICK! Do you have ANY idea what you have done?"
